fuzzyCriteria.sourceText: Part A and B: * Histologically or cytologically confirmed metastatic or unresectable solid malignancy including ovarian cancer...
fuzzyCriteria.reasonFuzzy: Eligibility rules are heavily partitioned into multiple parts, cohorts, and tumor types, making it impossible to express as a single global typed check.
